# do_BeeSwarmPlot() | Individual cell distributions

```{r}
#| results: "asis"
#| echo: false
source("../_common.R")
```

Beeswarm plots show individual cells as points, providing a detailed view of the data distribution.

## Basic usage

```{r}
#| eval: false
p <- SCpubr::do_BeeSwarmPlot(sample = sample,
                             features = "CD3D")
p
```
